The surfaced final node is app.set, which reads/writes application settings, a different receiver and implementation.
Attachment with a nonempty basename calls response type; redirect calls response location; both continue to the response setter.
Sending a non-null object routes to json, which directly calls stringify; this surfaced path is source-supported.
